course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Exceptions: explain a failure and preserve the original input
goal: Handle an expected conversion failure while preserving input and avoiding a false successful zero.

prerequisites.text: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.

sections.title: An operation may fail to produce a value
paragraphs: Число("30") produces a number; Число("ошибка") cannot perform the requested conversion. An exception interrupts the ordinary sequence. The remaining instructions in Попытка are skipped and control moves to Исключение. Результат = Истина is therefore not reached in the main example.

The initial flag is Ложь. It represents conversion success in this exercise only, not knowledge assessment, a saved document or permission to accept any number as a duration. Execution after КонецПопытки follows an explicitly chosen recovery path.

sections.title: Trace the main example
paragraphs: Conversion rejects the text, skips the success assignment and preserves the original input.

code.output: The prompt «Введите число минут, например 30» and the Boolean Ложь.

sections.title: Catch where you can provide a useful response
paragraphs: Keep the risky conversion in a narrow block. Combining many unrelated operations makes the failed action harder to identify. An empty exception handler hides a missing result while allowing the program to appear active.

A learner-facing message should explain the next action and give an example. Developers need reproducible steps and the failure location. Do not automatically publish raw diagnostics containing paths, records or connection details. This exercise retains its synthetic input in a local variable and sends nothing outside.

sections.title: Technical conversion is not business validation
paragraphs: The text "-1" can convert successfully. A negative duration still violates our service rule. Check the range after conversion; catching an exception does not replace that check or make an invalid value acceptable.

Distinguish unreadable text, a converted but unacceptable number, and an acceptable number. Zero can be valid under the chosen rule. Returning zero for every failure would erase the distinction between a known value and missing or rejected input.

sections.title: Corrected input follows the ordinary path
paragraphs: Rejecting every input is not a working solution, so test the positive path too.

code.source:
ИсходныйТекст = "30";
// Keep the rest of the main example unchanged.
code.output: No error prompt; Истина and Минуты=30.

sections.title: Make the failure reproducible
paragraphs: Record input, execution location, action, expected result and actual result. A synthetic string and short message suffice here; no full database, password or borrowed configuration is needed. A result from a different source version does not verify this experiment.

First run invalid text and observe the prompt and Ложь. Change only the input to "30": the prompt should disappear and the flag become Истина. Then investigate "-1" and specify the additional range check. This covers the recovery path and the ordinary path.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Continuing after a catch does not imply success. Track an explicit result and test valid and invalid input.
Converting -1 does not validate duration. Check the permitted duration range after conversion.
Raw technical errors should not be forwarded indiscriminately. Give actionable feedback and retain only non-sensitive technical diagnostics.

selfcheck.feedback: Conversion and business validation are different.

selfcheck.prompt: Why test "30" after an invalid string?
options: To verify the ordinary successful path

steps.title: Predict the result
steps.action: Identify the skipped instruction after conversion failure and explain the final flag.
steps.why: An expectation makes a wrong result detectable.
steps.expected: The prompt «Введите число минут, например 30» and the Boolean Ложь.
steps.troubleshooting: Use the trace to separate each instruction; do not copy a displayed total without explaining it.
steps.before: Your own training infobase opens and its startup handler already works. Preserve the preceding source before replacing this exercise body.

steps.title: Preserve your preceding work
steps.where: Your infobase → Designer → configuration root → managed application module
steps.action: Close only your own Enterprise session. Open your training copy in Designer. Preserve the previous module text separately. Keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler; replace only the preceding exercise body inside it. Do not replace modules of an unfamiliar application.
steps.why: The next exercise must not destroy the preceding version.
steps.expected: The intended module is open and the earlier source remains available.
steps.troubleshooting: If you cannot identify the infobase, return to the startup list and check its entry and directory.
steps.before: The prompt «Введите число минут, например 30» and the Boolean Ложь.

steps.title: Enter this example
steps.action: Copy the main example between the existing handler declaration and КонецПроцедуры. Do not add another handler. Read the explanation and identify what changes after each line.
steps.why: Conversion rejects the text, skips the success assignment and preserves the original input.
steps.expected: The exact exercise source is entered in the intended context.
steps.troubleshooting: Check ordinary quotes, semicolons and matching block endings. A syntax rejection is not execution.
steps.before: The intended module is open and the earlier source remains available.

steps.title: Save, update and execute
steps.where: Designer → Ctrl+S → Configuration / Update database configuration (F7) → Debug / Start (F5)
steps.action: Save your source, complete the database update and start Enterprise mode. Read the message area and compare each actual output with your prediction.
steps.why: Only the installed platform executes this BSL.
steps.expected: The prompt «Введите число минут, например 30» and the Boolean Ложь.
steps.troubleshooting: For old output close your client, verify the infobase and update again. For a different value find the first trace step that differs.
steps.before: The exact exercise source is entered in the intended context.

steps.title: Change one condition and retain evidence
steps.where: The same module, then Enterprise mode and Nexus notes
steps.action: Replace "ошибка" with "30" and run again. Separately try "-1" and explain why conversion does not prohibit it.
steps.why: A changed input tests understanding beyond copying the example.
steps.expected: 30 gives Истина without the prompt; -1 converts too and needs a separate rule.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not leave an empty handler, mark failure as success or substitute zero for an unknown result.
